items.title: Can Cars And Data Centers Carry Qualcomm Stock Past Apple?
items.summary: Qualcomm (QCOM) stock is up about 37% over the past six months, even after falling 21% over the past three. The case for the next leg rests outside phones, where management expects growth fast enough to cover a shrinking Apple business. The first real test arrives in the December quarter, when management expects its two custom data center wins to start producing revenue.
